cartridges.title: DSP1 Tech Demo (USA) (Tech Demo)
cartridges.source: snes-roms/5 Tools & Service Test Carts/ in the local library, the 131,072-byte file with this digest
cartridges.exercises: A DSP-1 driver this package reads. The image carries no header, so the sweep cannot name its part, and it reaches the DSP-1 only through absolute stores and loads made with the data bank set to BF, which the walk does not track: the search for long accesses finds no site and the walk from the vectors reaches none. conformance/testroms.py runs it on the stub console of conformance.executed under the DSP-1's low window and records how many instructions reach the part, through which data banks, and what the two readings find
